mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (indicated by a decline in industrial production below 108.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising input costs and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO falls below 108.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (indicated by GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS declines during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based supply shock that increases production costs and reduces economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
